setting: the top of the hill going down from the ward at quarter past eight, still out of breath from the stairs, traffic building behind him, he stops talking twice to let a bus pass
halfway down the hill, wind straight into the phone, telling the window story again in fewer words than the first time, a gate latch at the end
the last morning before the week off, longer and lighter than usual, gulls over the car park, he counts the days out loud twice and gets a different answer
flat and hoarse, standing still at the bottom of the hill rather than walking, the fire alarm story told once with no ending
